meta.label: Headline numbers from v1, each with its source file and what it means for the analogy. Exploratory; nothing here is a success claim.
limits: v1 is a screening method. It failed its negative controls and the ranking is not checked against independent data.
Every number here was stored by v1. Nothing was recomputed, apart from taking a maximum over a stored column.
Moon scoring is terrain only; Mars is a low-confidence secondary result.
Site coordinates used in the v1 tests are still provisional.
